name: State Agriculture Thesis Grant for M.Sc. Agriculture
benefit: 1. Under the scheme, the Thesis Grant will be given to students according to the course/programme in which they are enrolled.
_eligibility_text:
A student should fulfill the following criteria to be eligible for this Scholarship:

   1. The State Agriculture Thesis Grant will be applicable for all the inhabitants of Nagaland who passed the M.Sc. Agriculture.
   1. Applicants must be from an Institution which has a valid AISHE/UDISE code.
   1. Applicants must not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship scheme.
